title: AI Engineering Playbook - Project Manifest Schema
description: Technology-agnostic configuration manifest defining project identity, playbook standards, artifact paths, active lifecycle stage, and enabled governance capabilities.

$schema.description: URI reference to this JSON Schema.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema (e.g. 1.0.0).

project_name.description: Human-readable display name of the project.

description.description: Brief description of the project purpose and domain.

playbook.description: Governing playbook standards and rules profile.

version.description: Playbook standard version governing this project (e.g. 1.0.0).

repository_uri.description: Upstream playbook repository URL or git reference.

governance_profile.description: Governance rigor profile applied to stage gates.

approval_mode.description: Approval workflow: solo (in-chat human sign-off) vs team (formal PR reviews).

tech_stack.description: Technology stack metadata. Decoupled from core governance rules.

ecosystem.description: Primary software ecosystem (e.g. node, python, go, rust, java, agnostic).

primary_language.description: Primary programming language (e.g. typescript, python, go, agnostic).

runtimes.description: Target runtimes (e.g. node20, python3.12, jvm21, browser, posix).

frameworks.description: Primary application frameworks (e.g. nextjs, fastapi, react-native, gin).

package_manager.description: Package management tool (e.g. pnpm, npm, poetry, cargo, go-modules).

paths.description: Relative paths to project documentation and governance artifacts.

docs_root.description: Root path for project specifications and documentation.

gates_dir.description: Path to Stage Gate Exit Packages.

state_file.description: Relative path to machine-readable state JSON file.

active_lifecycle_stage.description: Currently active lifecycle stage (0: Discovery through 6: Deployment & Monitoring).

capabilities.description: Optional engineering capabilities and verification checks active for this project.
